description_en: This API restores historical data to a new cloned instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将历史数据恢复至一个新实例（称为克隆实例）
kebab_example: aliyun rds clone-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pay-type Postpaid --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloneDBInstance

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the latest regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary availability zone. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the latest availability zones.

Defaults to the availability zone of the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用区ID。

默认为源实例的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the new instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the new instance uses the instance type of the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。

默认规格和主实例一致
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the new instance. Unit: GB. The value must be a multiple of 5. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the new instance uses the storage capacity of the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储空间，单位：GB。每5GB进行递增，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html。
默认存储空间和主实例一致
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The description of the instance. The description must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~255个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en: The names of the databases that you want to clone. Format: `Source database 1,Source database 2`
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称，格式如下：`原库名1,原库名2`
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription.

Serverless: This billing method is not supported for MariaDB instances. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411291.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604344.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607742.html
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
Serverless：Serverless付费类型，不支持MariaDB实例。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411291.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604344.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607742.html
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

VPC

Classic

By default, the network type of the new instance is the same as that of the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络类型，取值：
VPC：专有网络
Classic：经典网络

默认网络类型和主实例一致
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set.

You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the backup list.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。

您可以通过DescribeBackups接口获取备份列表。

BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time must be within the backup retention period. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

Make sure that the VPC belongs to the required region
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC ID。
请确保VPC属于对应的地域
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch. The vSwitch must be in the same availability zone as specified by the ZoneId parameter.

The InstanceNetworkType parameter must be set to VPC.

If you specify ZoneSlaveId1, which specifies the ID of a secondary availability zone, you must specify two vSwitch IDs that are separated by a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。虚拟交换机所在的可用区必须和ZoneId中传入的可用区ID相对应。

网络类型InstanceNetworkType需为VPC。
若您填写了ZoneSlaveId1（备可用区ID），此处需填写两个交换机ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the new instance. The IP address must be within the CIDR block of the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns an IP address based on the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 新实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If you set the Period parameter to Year, the value of the UsedTime parameter is 1, 2, or 3.

If you set the Period parameter to Month, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 9.

If the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year

Month

If the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:

Basic

HighAvailability

AlwaysOn: Cluster Edition for SQL Server.

cluster: Cluster Edition for MySQL.

Finance: Enterprise Edition. This edition is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

Serverless instances

serverless_basic: Serverless Basic Edition. This edition is available only for instances that run MySQL and PostgreSQL.

serverless_standard: Serverless Standard Edition for MySQL.

serverless_ha: Serverless High-availability Edition for SQL Server.

You do not need to specify this parameter. The new instance is of the same edition as the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列，取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
AlwaysOn：集群系列（SQL Server）
cluster：集群系列（MySQL）
Finance：金融版（仅中国站支持）

Serverless实例
serverless_basic：Serverless基础系列（仅适用MySQL和PostgreSQL）
serverless_standard：MySQL Serverless高可用系列
serverless_ha：SQL Server Serverless高可用系列
该参数不需要传递，克隆时会保持和源实例相同
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary availability zone. If the value of this parameter is the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, the instance is deployed in a single availability zone. If the value is different, the instance is deployed in multiple availability zones
parameters.help_zh: 备节点可用区ID。如果和ZoneId相同，则为单可用区部署；如果和ZoneId不同，则为多可用区部署
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_1

parameters.help_en:
<props="intl">

The ID of the logger availability zone. If the value of this parameter is the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, the instance is deployed in a single availability zone. If the value is different, the instance is deployed in multiple availability zones.

</props>

<props="china">

The ID of the secondary or logger availability zone. If the value of this parameter is the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, the instance is deployed in a single availability zone. If the value is different, the instance is deployed in multiple availability zones.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="intl">日志节点可用区ID。如果和ZoneId相同，则为单可用区部署；如果和ZoneId不同，则为多可用区部署。</props>

<props="china">备节点或日志节点可用区ID。如果和ZoneId相同，则为单可用区部署；如果和ZoneId不同，则为多可用区部署。</props>
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

general_essd: general-purpose enhanced SSD (ESSD). Recommended.

local_ssd: local SSD.

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.

cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD.

cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.

cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD.

Serverless instances support only PL1 ESSDs and general-purpose ESSDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：

general_essd：高性能云盘（推荐）
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘

Serverless实例仅支持ESSD PL1云盘和高性能云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restore data to specific databases and tables. Set this parameter to 1. If you do not want to restore data to specific databases or tables, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 是否进行库表恢复，取值为true时表示进行库表恢复，否则不填
parameters.name: restore_table

parameters.help_en:
The databases and tables that you want to restore. This parameter is required if you set the RestoreTable parameter to 1. The value is a JSON string in the following format:
`[{"type":"db","name":"Name of database 1","newname":"Name of new database 1","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"Name of table 1 in database 1","newname":"Name of new table 1"},{"type":"table","name":"Name of table 2 in database 1","newname":"Name of new table 2"}]},{"type":"db","name":"Name of database 2","newname":"Name of new database 2","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"Name of table 1 in database 2","newname":"Name of new table 1"},{"type":"table","name":"Name of table 2 in database 2","newname":"Name of new table 2"}]}]`
parameters.help_zh:
进行库表恢复时，指定恢复的库表信息。格式：
```[{"type":"db","name":"数据库1名称","newname":"新数据库1名称","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"数据库1内的表1名称","newname":"新的表1名称"},{"type":"table","name":"数据库1内的表2名称","newname":"新的表2名称"}]},{"type":"db","name":"数据库2名称","newname":"新数据库2名称","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"数据库2内的表1名称","newname":"新的表1名称"},{"type":"table","name":"数据库2内的表2名称","newname":"新的表2名称"}]}]```
parameters.name: table_meta

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

FullBackup: full backup.

IncrementalBackup: incremental backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：

FullBackup：全量备份
IncrementalBackup：增量备份
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature. Valid values:

true: enables the feature.

false (default): disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启释放保护功能。取值：
true：开启
false（默认）：关闭
parameters.name: deletion_protection

fields.help_zh:
是否开启MySQL Serverless实例的自动启停功能。10分钟无任何连接进入暂停状态，连接进入时会自动唤醒。取值：

true：启用
false（默认）：不启用

仅MySQL Serverless实例支持该参数。
该参数仅支持中国站
fields.name: auto_pause

fields.help_zh:
实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）的自动扩缩范围最大值。取值：

MySQL：1~8
SQL Server：2~8
PostgreSQL：1~12

该参数的值必须大于等于MinCapacity，且仅支持传入整数。
该参数仅支持中国站
fields.name: max_capacity

fields.help_zh:
实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）的自动扩缩范围最小值。取值：

MySQL：0.5~8
SQL Server：2~8（仅支持整数）
PostgreSQL：0.5~12

该参数的值必须小于等于MaxCapacity。
该参数仅支持中国站
fields.name: min_capacity

fields.help_zh:
是否开启MySQL Serverless实例的强制弹性扩缩容。实例RCU的弹性扩缩容通常会立刻生效，但在某些特殊情况下无法即时完成扩缩容，此时可开启本参数进行强制扩缩容。取值：

true：启用
false（默认）：不启用

仅MySQL Serverless实例支持该参数。
该参数仅支持中国站
fields.name: switch_force

parameters.help_en: The ServerlessConfig
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless选项。仅在需要将数据克隆至Serverless实例时传入。

该参数仅支持中国站
parameters.name: serverless_config

parameters.help_en: The BpeEnabled
parameters.help_zh: 弃用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: bpe_enabled

parameters.help_en:
A parameter that is related to serverless instances. Specify this parameter only when you clone data to a serverless instance.

This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能开关，取值：

1：开启
0：不开启

Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.name: io_acceleration_enabled

parameters.help_en: This parameter is discontinued. You no longer need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的IO性能突发功能开关。
true：开启
false：关闭
了解IO性能突发功能的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature for a general-purpose ESSD. Valid values:

1: enables the feature.

0: does not enable the feature.

For more information about BPE, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。
取值范围：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。

false：只生成订单不扣费。




默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the I/O burst feature for a general-purpose ESSD.

true: enables the feature.

false: does not enable the feature.

For more information about the I/O burst feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html
parameters.help_zh: The CustomExtraInfo
parameters.name: custom_extra_info

DBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the new instance

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the associated order
